<description>
Closes https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/36755

To cover `-rpcservertimeout` behavior our test expected the Bitcoin Core HTTP server to disconnect the test framework client after the configured duration but also *before* a somewhat arbitrary upper bound. This was helpful during development of #35182 but has led to false negatives in CI on platforms that are just plain slow.

Solve the flakiness by simply deleting the test case. Note that a regression is still caught by both the functional test and unit test suite. #36159 added a mock clock in the unit test to assert the disconnect timing. A server with no timeout would also fail the functional test which will time out during `sock.recv()` waiting for the EOF.

Both regression test failures can be observed on top of this branch by disabling rpcservertimeout:

```diff

index 069eace507..7a090c4ca8 100644

+++ b/src/httpserver.cpp

                  "HTTP client idle timeout %s (id=%llu)",
                  m_origin,
                  m_id);
-        return true;
+        return false;
```
